name: mcp-telegram-bridge
description: Stdio MCP bridge to the Telegram Bot API with outbound scrubbing and fail-closed chat admission.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.title: Telegram bot token
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Required token created with Telegram BotFather.

ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS.title: Allowed chat IDs
ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram chat IDs. Empty denies every chat unless ALLOW_ALL_CHATS is enabled.

ALLOW_ALL_CHATS.title: Allow all chats
ALLOW_ALL_CHATS.description: Set to 1, true, yes, or on to permit every chat. Leave unset. Ignored when ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS is set. Startup warns on stderr.

SAFETY_STRICT.title: Strict safety mode
SAFETY_STRICT.description: Heuristic inbound labels. Default is on. Set to 0, false, no, or off to disable. Not a prompt-injection filter.
